mutants.description: Swap quantifiers for continuity from forall eps exists delta to exists delta forall eps (forcing universal delta independent of epsilon).
mutants.falsification_mechanism: Quantifier alternating order violation detected by QuantifierChecker.

mutants.description: Provide a purported uniform continuity modulus delta(eps, x) = min(eps, x/2) for f(x)=1/x on (0, 1) that leaks variable x.
mutants.falsification_mechanism: QuantifierChecker rejects witness because delta depends on forbidden spatial variable x.

mutants.description: Attempt to certify uniform convergence of f_n(x) = x^n on [0, 1) by evaluating point samples without supremum norm bound.
mutants.falsification_mechanism: CertificateChecker rejects point grid promotion to uniform certificate.

mutants.description: Assert Extreme Value Theorem on non-compact open interval (0, 1) for f(x) = 1/x (unbounded).
mutants.falsification_mechanism: Exact arithmetic detects sup f = infty on (0, 1) with no attained maximum.

mutants.description: Assert uniform continuity of f(x) = 1/x on non-compact domain (0, 1).
mutants.falsification_mechanism: Evaluator finds points x_n = 1/n, y_n = 1/(2n) with |x_n - y_n| -> 0 but |f(x_n) - f(y_n)| = n -> infty.

mutants.description: Assert convergence of unbounded monotone sequence x_n = n.
mutants.falsification_mechanism: Sequence divergence detected; no finite real limit L exists.

mutants.description: Claim harmonic series sum_{n=1}^infty 1/n converges.
mutants.falsification_mechanism: Cauchy criterion failure: block sum sum_{k=n+1}^{2n} 1/k >= 1/2 for all n.

mutants.description: Claim alternating harmonic series sum (-1)^{n+1}/n converges absolutely.
mutants.falsification_mechanism: Absolute series is harmonic series sum 1/n which diverges.

mutants.description: Assert continuity of Heaviside unit step function H(x) at x = 0.
mutants.falsification_mechanism: Left limit 0 != right limit 1, violating eps-delta continuity for eps = 1/2.

mutants.description: Assert differentiability of f(x) = |x| at x = 0.
mutants.falsification_mechanism: Left difference quotient -1 != right difference quotient +1.

mutants.description: Apply Mean Value Theorem to discontinuous function f(x) = 0 on [0, 1), f(1) = 1.
mutants.falsification_mechanism: Secant slope (1-0)/(1-0) = 1, but f'(x) = 0 for all x in (0, 1), so no c in (0, 1) exists with f'(c) = 1.

mutants.description: Assert that f_n(x) = x^n converges uniformly on closed interval [0, 1].
mutants.falsification_mechanism: Pointwise limit is discontinuous at 1, violating uniform limit preservation of continuity.

mutants.description: Accept an infinite subcover {(1/n, 1) : n in N} as valid witness for compactness of (0, 1).
mutants.falsification_mechanism: CertificateChecker verifies subcover cardinality and rejects non-finite index sets.

mutants.description: Reverse Taylor remainder inequality to assert |f(x) - P_k(x)| > R_k(x).
mutants.falsification_mechanism: Evaluator detects inequality sign inversion against certified Lagrange remainder.

mutants.description: Provide a non-monotonic or overlapping partition array x_0 < x_2 < x_1 < x_3 for Darboux integration.
mutants.falsification_mechanism: ExactArithmetic partition validator rejects non-strictly increasing partition points.

mutants.description: Pass binary float interval [0.1, 0.2] into proof-eligible certificate checker.
mutants.falsification_mechanism: ExactArithmetic raises TypeError on float input in proof-eligible evidence pipeline.

mutants.description: Submit a proof witness object missing required Lagrange remainder certificate keys.
mutants.falsification_mechanism: Evaluator fails schema validation due to missing required witness keys.

mutants.description: Inject concept ID string into RedactedSemanticWitness normalized values.
mutants.falsification_mechanism: Redacted evaluator sanitizes and rejects witnesses containing non-mathematical identifier keys.
